newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian import prices rise 0.1 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Australian import prices rise 0.1 pct in May.

text.p: Australian import prices rose 0.1 percent in May from the previous month and were 2.6 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
"The value of the Australian dollar fell against the major trading currencies, leading to a small rise in the index in May," the bureau said.
The biggest contributing factors to the increase were higher prices for machinery and transport equipment and coffee.
These were partly offset by price falls for petroleum and related products and fertilizers, the bureau said.
